fees.notes: Official Sunway University international student annual fee (Year 2026): USD 7,442, published on the programme page and payable in RM equivalent at the prevailing exchange rate. Total (USD 16,744.5) derived as annual fee x 2.25 years. Source: https://sunwayuniversity.edu.my/faculty-of-arts-and-social-sciences/courses/diploma-interior-design, fetched 2026-09-18.

requirements.general: SPM/O-Level Pass with min. 3 credits UEC Pass with min. 3 Bs Other Equivalent Qualifications Pass in Certificate (Level 3, MQF) or equivalent in related fields Must be accredited by MQA Special Requirements Pass a Portfolio review: Please submit a minimum of 3 pieces of your own creative work in any genre and mediums: Drawing  Painting Photography Digital Illustration Clay Art Fashion-Related Art Projects Any other medium OR Pass an interview *In cases where students’ portfolio does not meet expectations.
